purpose: Selected primary sources; review_scope states how far each was checked. No performance claim for CareerSim is established.

sources.label: MCTS-AHD
sources.relevance: Outer tree of generated heuristics, progressive widening and retention of weak ancestors.
sources.limitation: Its max backup and benchmark evaluation are not a calibrated estimator for noisy game episodes.
sources.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Comprehensive Exploration in LLM-Based Automatic Heuristic Design

sources.label: AB-MCTS
sources.relevance: Explicit generation action decides whether to branch wider or refine deeper.
sources.limitation: Bayesian node model is an assumption; a GEN node is not an ordinary fixed arm.
sources.title: Wider or Deeper? Scaling LLM Inference-Time Compute with Adaptive Branching Tree Search
sources.author_comment: Accepted as a spotlight at NeurIPS 2025

sources.label: ShinkaEvolve
sources.relevance: Archive, island populations, novelty screening and adaptive mutation-model selection.
sources.limitation: Mutation-model selection is distinct from fidelity of a model playing the game.
sources.title: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution

sources.label: AdaEvolve
sources.relevance: Local exploration intensity, global allocation across islands and meta-guidance.
sources.limitation: Reported gains on algorithm tasks do not establish robustness on this game's noisy objective.
sources.title: AdaEvolve: Adaptive LLM Driven Zeroth-Order Optimization

sources.label: GEPA
sources.relevance: Use execution traces to propose targeted instruction revisions and maintain a candidate frontier.
sources.limitation: No transfer of its percentage gains or rollout savings is assumed for CareerSim.
sources.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning

sources.label: ReEvo
sources.relevance: Reflective evolution provides language feedback for heuristic improvement.
sources.limitation: Verbal gradients are feedback heuristics, not derivatives of the true game score.
sources.title: ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution

sources.label: FunSearch
sources.relevance: A trusted evaluator can filter LLM-generated candidates; islands retain diversity.
sources.limitation: Needs a valid evaluator; the original maths/code setting differs from an agent game.
sources.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models

sources.label: AlphaEvolve
sources.relevance: Evaluator-guided evolution separates proposal generation from objective assessment.
sources.limitation: A cheap model generating code is not evidence that a cheap actor preserves policy rankings.
sources.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery

sources.label: Darwin Godel Machine
sources.relevance: Archive of agent designs supports open-ended descendants rather than one greedy lineage.
sources.limitation: Self-modification and code/tool changes cannot simply be imported into the competition submission.
sources.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents

sources.label: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
sources.relevance: Meta-agent search over an archive of agent designs.
sources.limitation: Broad agent architecture search exceeds the track's fixed runtime permissions.
sources.title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems

sources.label: AIDE
sources.relevance: Separate drafting, debugging and atomic improvements; preserve concise search summaries.
sources.limitation: Its simple best-node improvement rule is a baseline, not proof that greedy search is sufficient.
sources.title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code

sources.label: EvoTest
sources.relevance: Actor/evolver loop revises agent configuration between game episodes.
sources.limitation: Its cross-episode state-action memory may conflict with this track's fixed-answer prohibition.
sources.title: EvoTest: Evolutionary Test-Time Learning for Self-Improving Agentic Systems

sources.label: Meta-TTL
sources.relevance: Optimise the rule for improving a policy, not only the policy itself.
sources.limitation: Current API title differs from an older indexed version; requires broader tasks/meta-training.
sources.title: Meta-TTL: Meta-Learning Self-Improvement Policies for Language Agents
sources.title_alias_in_older_index: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies

sources.label: PACEvolve++
sources.relevance: Adapts evolutionary-search guidance by training an advisor as search progresses.
sources.limitation: Training an advisor and using a separate implementation model is not the fixed official setup.
sources.title: PACEvolve++: Improving Test-time Learning for Evolutionary Search Agents

sources.label: TreeFlex
sources.relevance: Branch cards and path-specific context support deliberate revisit and clean execution context.
sources.limitation: 14 October preprint; trained navigation and restored task state do not imply game-state rollback.
sources.title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees

sources.label: TreeSeeker
sources.relevance: Branch-attached evidence, uncertainty and failure cues support return decisions.
sources.limitation: Deep-search benchmark and textual UCB are not calibrated career-policy confidence bounds.
sources.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search

sources.label: Empirical-MCTS
sources.relevance: Couples local search with cross-problem memory management.
sources.limitation: Reasoning benchmarks and retained experience differ from permitted current-run game information.
sources.title: Empirical-MCTS: Continuous Agent Evolution via Dual-Experience Monte Carlo Tree Search

sources.label: SPARK
sources.relevance: Concentrates branching at informative decision states during long-horizon agent training.
sources.limitation: Depends on training/branching capabilities absent from the documented live MCP interface.
sources.title: SPARK: Strategic Policy-Aware Exploration via Dynamic Branching for Long-Horizon Agentic Learning

sources.label: HOO
sources.relevance: Formal hierarchical optimistic search over a structured space of actions.
sources.limitation: Locally Lipschitz/similarity assumptions are not established for prompt mutations.
sources.title: X-Armed Bandits

sources.label: StoSOO
sources.relevance: Noisy coarse-to-fine optimisation with hierarchical partitions and unknown smoothness.
sources.limitation: Does not remove all regularity assumptions or guarantee arbitrary semantic-tree search.
sources.title: Stochastic Simultaneous Optimistic Optimization

sources.label: Procrastinated Tree Search
sources.relevance: Hierarchical optimisation with delayed, noisy and multi-fidelity feedback.
sources.limitation: Its bias/smoothness/delay assumptions must be checked; successful long games have informative duration.
sources.title: Procrastinated Tree Search: Black-Box Optimization with Delayed, Noisy, and Multi-Fidelity Feedback

sources.label: BAST
sources.relevance: Shows pathological UCT behaviour and motivates smooth-tree confidence-based pruning.
sources.limitation: Unknown descendants cannot be safely bounded by one parent's observed score without assumptions.
sources.title: Bandit Algorithms for Tree Search

sources.label: MAP-Elites
sources.relevance: Keep good policies in different behavioural niches rather than only the global best.
sources.limitation: Descriptors and niche estimates must be reliable; diversity is not itself the competition score.
sources.title: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites

sources.label: QD populations
sources.relevance: Evolve diverse populations with separate hyperparameters/learnable components.
sources.limitation: RL population training differs from frozen LLM policy testing.
sources.title: Evolving Populations of Diverse RL Agents with MAP-Elites

sources.label: Go-Explore
sources.relevance: Archives preserve useful stepping stones and support return before new exploration.
sources.limitation: Do not assume its environment-state restoration is allowed or available here.
sources.title: First return, then explore
sources.author_comment: 47 pages, 14 figures, 4 tables; reorganized sections and modified SI text extensively; added reference to the published version, changed title to published title; added reference to published unformatted pdf

sources.label: POET
sources.relevance: Alternative paths and transferred stepping stones can solve deceptive tasks.
sources.limitation: Generating or modifying game environments is not authorised by the official MCP tools.
sources.title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions

sources.label: PBT
sources.relevance: Asynchronous exploit/explore across a population; schedules can outperform a fixed setting.
sources.limitation: Training checkpoint inheritance is not cloning a valid game state.
sources.title: Population Based Training of Neural Networks

sources.label: PB2
sources.relevance: Model-guided adaptation of population hyperparameters.
sources.limitation: Theoretical efficiency concerns its model and assumptions, not arbitrary prompt workers.
sources.title: Provably Efficient Online Hyperparameter Optimization with Population-Based Bandits

sources.label: Hyperband
sources.relevance: Allocate more evaluation resource to promising candidates in staged comparisons.
sources.limitation: Use episode count as resource; a shorter game horizon can reverse strategy ranking.
sources.title: Hyperband: A Novel Bandit-Based Approach to Hyperparameter Optimization

sources.label: ASHA
sources.relevance: Practical asynchronous allocation among many jobs.
sources.limitation: Fast early failures and slow successful episodes require careful handling of pending work.
sources.title: A System for Massively Parallel Hyperparameter Tuning
sources.journal_ref: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems 2020
sources.author_comment: v2: Corrected typo in Algorithm 1 v3: Added comparison to BOHB and parallel version of synchronous SHA. Add PBT to experiment in Section 4.3.1 v4: Added acknowledgements and slight edit to related work

sources.label: BOHB
sources.relevance: Combines model-guided proposals with staged resource allocation.
sources.limitation: Low-resource estimates must be informative about the real target.
sources.title: BOHB: Robust and Efficient Hyperparameter Optimization at Scale

sources.label: TuRBO
sources.relevance: Local Bayesian search is useful for bounded numeric design knobs.
sources.limitation: Prompt-text proximity does not automatically define a smooth numeric objective.
sources.title: Scalable Global Optimization via Local Bayesian Optimization
sources.journal_ref: In Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32, pages 5497-5508. 2019
sources.author_comment: Appears in NeurIPS 2019 as a spotlight paper

sources.label: Robust MFBO
sources.relevance: Unreliable cheap sources can increase cost; robust source handling matters.
sources.limitation: No guarantee cheap and target gameplay models are positively correlated in this task.
sources.title: Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization with Unreliable Information Sources
sources.author_comment: Accepted for publication at AISTATS 2023. Code available at https://github.com/AaltoPML/rMFBO
sources.venue_or_source_type: AISTATS 2023, acceptance reported in author record

sources.label: Multi-information source optimisation
sources.relevance: Choose both an input/candidate and the information source used to measure it.
sources.limitation: Source-specific bias/noise must not be hidden in a pooled average.
sources.title: Multi-Information Source Optimization
sources.author_comment: Added: benchmark logistic regression on MNIST/USPS, comparison to MTBO/entropy search, estimation of hyper-parameters

sources.label: Input-dependent fidelity
sources.relevance: Source fidelity can change across regions of the input space.
sources.limitation: A global Haiku-to-target correlation does not validate every new policy family.
sources.title: Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization with Multiple Information Sources of Input-dependent Fidelity

sources.label: Top-two best-arm identification
sources.relevance: Allocate measurement effort to distinguish credible contenders for final selection.
sources.limitation: Fixed-alternative statistical guarantees differ from generation of unobserved descendants.
sources.title: Simple Bayesian Algorithms for Best Arm Identification

sources.label: Modern top-two analysis
sources.relevance: A modern theoretical reference on optimal top-two selection under its setting.
sources.limitation: No universal finite-budget optimality is inferred for this open-ended search.
sources.title: Optimal Top-Two Method for Best Arm Identification and Fluid Analysis

sources.label: Confidence sequences
sources.relevance: Time-uniform intervals support repeated looks and optional stopping under assumptions.
sources.limitation: Adaptive policy changes, actor changes and environment drift define new estimands/epochs.
sources.title: Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences

sources.label: Statistical precipice
sources.relevance: Show distributions and uncertainty rather than only top scores.
sources.limitation: Auxiliary robust summaries do not replace the official arithmetic mean.
sources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
sources.author_comment: Outstanding Paper Award at NeurIPS 2021. Website: https://agarwl.github.io/rliable. 28 Pages, 33 Figures

sources.label: Options
sources.relevance: Initiation, subpolicy and termination formalise context-dependent modes over time.
sources.limitation: A discovered month index is not proof of a causal regime change.
sources.title: Between MDPs and semi-MDPs: A framework for temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning

sources.label: policytree
sources.relevance: Interpretable policy trees provide an alternative to opaque routing.
sources.limitation: Offline causal estimators need assumptions/data not supplied by the current aggregate logs.
sources.title: policytree: Policy learning via doubly robust empirical welfare maximization over trees

sources.label: MAPO
sources.relevance: Prompt effectiveness depends on the actor model.
sources.limitation: The preprint reports earlier EMNLP acceptance; use explicit source dates rather than conflating them.
sources.title: MAPO: Boosting Large Language Model Performance with Model-Adaptive Prompt Optimization

sources.label: S2LPP
sources.relevance: Some task families support useful small-to-large prompt preference transfer.
sources.limitation: Useful transfer in QA/NLI does not guarantee transfer in long-horizon gameplay.
sources.title: S2LPP: Small-to-Large Prompt Prediction across LLMs

sources.label: Concept distillation
sources.relevance: A strong model can diagnose weak-model mistakes and propose general concepts.
sources.limitation: Rules distilled from named game answers or hidden formulas cannot be imported into the submission.
sources.title: Concept Distillation from Strong to Weak Models via Hypotheses-to-Theories Prompting

sources.label: Research-agent search comparison
sources.relevance: Study search policies/operators/evaluators in a common research-agent environment.
sources.limitation: This is AIRA-dojo's comparative paper, not the original AIDE paper.
sources.title: AI Research Agents for Machine Learning: Search, Exploration, and Generalization in MLE-bench

sources.label: Unagi ICFP 2025
sources.relevance: Winning team focused AI search on a measurable bottleneck and reused resulting insights.
sources.limitation: 320 trials/about USD 60 describe that subexperiment, not total winning cost or an LLM-only win.
sources.title: ShinkaEvolve in Action: How a Human-AI Partnership Conquered a Coding Challenge

sources.label: ALE-Agent AHC058
sources.relevance: Diverse construction and structural mutations can outperform narrow local tweaks.
sources.limitation: Known simulator and roughly USD 1300 setup differ from the current key/budget constraints.
sources.title: Sakana AI Agent Wins AtCoder Heuristic Contest (First AI to Place 1st)

sources.label: Anthropic multi-agent research
sources.relevance: Independent contexts, clear delegation and controlled summaries fit parallel independent episodes.
sources.limitation: Vendor research evaluation is not evidence of a game advantage; coordination increases token consumption.
sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system

sources.label: Competition rules
sources.relevance: Binding platform/model/interface/fair-play requirements and scoring.
sources.limitation: Research architecture is not organiser approval for external models, concurrency or bulk experimentation.
sources.title: Competition rules and fair play

sources.label: Official MCP
sources.relevance: Five tools and stdio transport define the available interface.
sources.limitation: No documented state clone, undo, arbitrary initial state or simulator seed parameter.
sources.title: Configuring the track MCP server

sources.label: Submission requirements
sources.relevance: English deliverables, real video, consistent design evidence and valid structure.
sources.limitation: A research laboratory is not the final ZIP; keep Spanish research and runtime data out of it.
sources.title: Submission requirements

sources.label: Opus 5.5
sources.relevance: Confirms requested orchestrator model and published API ID/base pricing.
sources.limitation: Availability in the user's API account and fitness for this game were not tested.
sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 availability and pricing

sources.label: Haiku 5.5
sources.relevance: Confirms requested cheap worker and prompt-length-dependent base pricing.
sources.limitation: Low price or generic subagent capability does not establish reliable strategy ranking.
sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 availability and pricing

sources.label: Sonnet 5.5
sources.relevance: Confirms requested escalation worker and published API ID/base pricing.
sources.limitation: Treat model escalation as a changed experimental condition.
sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 availability and pricing

sources.label: Scientific Agent Skills
sources.relevance: Procedural literature lookup skill used to check metadata and identifier shape.
sources.limitation: This supports retrieval provenance, not any claim about the proposed game strategy.
sources.title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
sources.author_comment: 31 pages, 16 figures, 2 tables, 1 listing. v2: adds a figure of how the documented workflows compose skills, quotes the skill clauses behind the introduction's examples, replaces the appendix listing with a procedural skill, names supported hosts and the pinned install path, and reports the two corpus findings in the abstract
